crossRefs.note: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.
This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and…
Yahweh’s hand was on Elijah; and he tucked his cloak into his belt and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
“You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and say to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them…
Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at…
Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

translations.web: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
translations.bsb: Now brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall inform Me.
translations.kjv: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer
translations.asv: Gird up now thy loins like a man; For I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
